posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Wager Master vs Nightmist, Rogue KNYFE, Setback, and Cpt. Cosmic in Atlantis.

1st Villain turn: Starts with 3 Wagelings, and Not All He Seems in play

Pick A Card ends in a bust. Nothing happens.

1st Hero turns: Nightmist plays her Amulet. KNYFE just uses a power. Setback drops Looking Up. Cosmic plays some constructs.

1st Enviro turn: Front of Power gets played.

Wager Master plays An Unwise Wager.

Nightmist plays Mists of Time

"Umm...did that just happen?"

Game over. Heros lose.
